entry.title: Great Consensus Cleanup Revival
entry.summary:
An analysis of mainnet block retargets reveals that out of 483 instances spanning from block 2,016 to 973,728, there were only ten occasions where the first block of a new period was timestamped earlier than the last block of the preceding period. The most significant negative offset occurred at block 203,616 on 16 October 2012, with a discrepancy of -1,127 seconds. A grace period of 600 seconds would have resulted in the rejection of this block unless it was timestamped at or after 23:04:55. Since 2015, the largest negative offset recorded is -43 seconds at block 812,448.
No observed instance approaches a threshold of 7,200 seconds, and every period maintains a positive total span, indicating robust adherence to chronological order within block periods. For those interested in further examination, comprehensive data on each seam is available in a [CSV file](https://www.learnbitcoin.com/downloads/time-warp-seams.csv), which is referenced in an explanatory write-up accessible [here](https://www.learnbitcoin.com/rabbit-hole/time-warp).
